# monkeytester

> Bugs your tests didn't think to look for. Point it at a URL. It finds the bugs, then proves you fixed them.

Open-source AGPL-3.0 TypeScript CLI and library. Package `@monkeytestai/monkeytester`. Command `monkeytest`. Node.js 20+. Playwright and your own LLM. Not a hosted REST API and not an MCP server.

npm dist-tag `latest` is the stable channel. npm dist-tag `next` is the pre-release channel. This tree's version is `package.json` (`monkeytest version`). It is not the hosted product.

Registry observation on 8 November 2026 at 10:16 IST, not a pin: `latest` 0.7.1, `next` 0.7.2-beta.2. Re-check with `npm view @monkeytestai/monkeytester dist-tags --json`.

The hosted API and worker were observed running 0.7.0 (droplet checkout `60def87b`). The image revision is unproven. Unset safety flags do not establish safety defaults. npm `latest` and `next` are not live SaaS protection.

https://docs.monkeytest.ai/getting-started/versions

Hosted cloud: https://monkeytest.ai

## What it does

You pass a URL. The engine crawls with Playwright, files findings that carry evidence, and can replay a stored trace (`rerun`) and compare bug fingerprints (`diff`). A flow is `passed` only when its outcome check verifies. Otherwise the result stays inconclusive. Coverage is the pages reached under the depth cap, not the whole site. Confirm a filed bug on the site before treating the run as the whole story.

Contact, enquiry, feedback, support, quote, and get-in-touch messages are not sent. Password reset, OTP, newsletter, payment, and account deletion stay blocked unless you pass your own inbox or the library `allowSensitive` path the engine already documents. There is no hosted inbox.

The false-positive gate (under 10% on a fixed 10-site set) has not been measured. A 0% note on two sites is not that gate.

https://docs.monkeytest.ai/guides/quality
https://docs.monkeytest.ai/guides/how-is-this-different

Commands for the first report: `monkeytest run`, `monkeytest report`, `monkeytest open` (local evidence paths only), `monkeytest rerun`, `monkeytest diff prev latest`.

`node scripts/smoke.mjs` is a stub LLM. It is not real-model testing.

Old paths such as `/guide/quick-start`, `/guide/why-monkeytest`, `/guide/llm-providers`, `/guide/cost-and-depth`, and `/reference/overview` redirect.
